sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，网址是nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: A major new poll from The Times finds that the political honeymoon is over for Vice President Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的一项重要新民调显示，副总统卡玛拉·哈里斯的政治蜜月期已经结束。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Nate Cohn on how some of Harris's strengths from just a few weeks ago are now becoming her weaknesses and the opening that that is creating for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事内特·科恩将分析哈里斯几周前的优势为何正逐渐变成劣势，以及这为唐纳德·特朗普创造了怎样的机会。

sentences.en: It's Monday, September 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月9日，星期一。

sentences.en: Nate, welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 内特，欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: So, Nate, you have always made clear to us that in a presidential campaign, polls are a snapshot of a political moment in time.
sentences.zh: 那么，内特，你一直向我们明确表示，在总统竞选中，民调只是特定政治时刻的快照。

sentences.en: And the last time we took that kind of snapshot, back in August,
sentences.zh: 而我们上次进行那种快照调查是在八月份，

sentences.en: Kamala Harris had just replaced Joe Biden as the Democratic nominee.
sentences.zh: 当时卡玛拉·哈里斯刚刚接替乔·拜登成为民主党候选人。

sentences.en: And for Harris, it was a very good snapshot.
sentences.zh: 对哈里斯来说，那是一份非常好的快照。

sentences.en: Talk to us about this latest poll that we did and what it reveals about this moment in time.
sentences.zh: 跟我们谈谈我们做的这份最新民调，以及它揭示了当下的什么情况。

sentences.en: Well, when we last talked, we had just found Kamala Harris moving ahead of Donald Trump in the key battleground states.
sentences.zh: 嗯，上次我们交谈时，我们刚发现卡玛拉·哈里斯在关键摇摆州的支持率领先于唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And now we have a little bit of a different story.
sentences.zh: 而现在情况有些不同了。

sentences.en: The most recent poll today shows Donald Trump narrowly ahead of Kamala Harris nationwide,
sentences.zh: 今天最新的民调显示，唐纳德·特朗普在全国范围内以微弱优势领先卡玛拉·哈里斯，

sentences.en: 48 to 47 percent.
And how should we understand that?
sentences.zh: 我们该如何理解这一点？

sentences.en: I mean, that is a very, very close race.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一场非常、非常胶着的竞选。

sentences.en: What's behind it?
sentences.zh: 背后的原因是什么？

sentences.en: It's a very close race.
sentences.zh: 这是一场非常胶着的竞选。

sentences.en: And before we go too much further, it's worth putting a few caveats out there.
sentences.zh: 在深入探讨之前，有必要先提出几点注意事项。

sentences.en: Not many other polls show Donald Trump in a lead nationwide.
sentences.zh: 并没有多少其他民调显示唐纳德·特朗普在全国范围内领先。

sentences.en: In fact, this is the first poll to show him with a lead in nearly a month.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这是近一个月来第一个显示他领先的民调。

sentences.en: So we have to be cautious until there are other polls that back it up.
sentences.zh: 所以，在有其他民调支持这一结果之前，我们必须保持谨慎。

sentences.en: It's possible this is a little bit of a statistical outlier.
sentences.zh: 这可能只是一个统计上的异常值。

sentences.en: But I do think it's possible, maybe even likely, that Trump has been gaining ground over the last few weeks.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，特朗普在过去几周里可能，甚至很可能，正在获得支持。

sentences.en: Kamala Harris enjoyed a fantastic month from the end of July through the Democratic Convention.
sentences.zh: 从7月底到民主党全国代表大会期间，卡玛拉·哈里斯度过了一个美妙的月份。

sentences.en: It's easy to imagine how that propelled her numbers to unsustainable heights.
sentences.zh: 不难想象，这如何将她的支持率推向了不可持续的高度。

sentences.en: And the last two weeks, while they've been arguably perfectly fine for Kamala Harris, they haven't been the same as they were for much of last month.
sentences.zh: 而过去两周，虽然对卡玛拉·哈里斯来说可以说表现尚可，但与上个月的大部分时间相比，情况已不尽相同。

sentences.en: So it wouldn't be terribly surprising if her numbers have begun to fade a bit.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果她的支持率开始有所下滑，也不会让人感到特别惊讶。

sentences.en: Okay, so basically there is a chance that this poll is telling us that the honeymoon is over, so to speak, right?
sentences.zh: 好的，所以基本上这个民调有可能是在告诉我们，所谓的蜜月期已经结束了，对吧？

sentences.en: The momentum is no longer propelling her forward.
sentences.zh: 势头不再推动她前进。

sentences.en: And instead, Trump is ascendant.
sentences.zh: 相反，特朗普正在崛起。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It would suggest that she's come a little bit back to earth now that there isn't this wave of euphoria that greeted her initial candidacy.
sentences.zh: 这表明，随着迎接她最初参选的那股狂热浪潮消退，她现在已经稍微回归现实了。

sentences.en: Okay, so caveats aside, break these results down for us.
sentences.zh: 好的，抛开注意事项不谈，请为我们分析一下这些结果。

sentences.en: So back in August, what you told us was that Harris appeared to be benefiting mightily from being the fresh face in the race.
sentences.zh: 八月份的时候，你告诉我们，哈里斯似乎从作为竞选中的“新鲜面孔”中获益良多。

sentences.en: Not Biden, not Trump, but instead a kind of hazy Democratic ideal.
sentences.zh: 不是拜登，也不是特朗普，而是一种模糊的民主党理想化身。

sentences.en: Somebody who wasn't taking too many bold positions or really defining herself with great detail in any way at all.
sentences.zh: 一个没有采取太多激进立场，也没有以任何方式详细定义自己的人。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, I likened it to her being something like a generic Democrat.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我把它比作她就像一个“普通民主党人”。

sentences.en: And that sounds a little insulting, but it's really not.
sentences.zh: 这听起来有点冒犯，但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: When pollsters ask, would you rather vote for a generic Democrat or Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 当民调人员问，你更愿意投票给一个普通的民主党人还是唐纳德·特朗普时？

sentences.en: Generic Democrat does great.
sentences.zh: 普通民主党人的表现非常好。

sentences.en: And that's more or less how Kamala Harris was running, right?
sentences.zh: 而这或多或少就是卡玛拉·哈里斯当时的竞选方式，对吧？

sentences.en: She was advancing boilerplate Democratic messaging on abortion and helping the middle class and democracy.
sentences.zh: 她正在推进关于堕胎、帮助中产阶级和民主的常规民主党信息。

sentences.en: And the risk involved in that, though, was that by running as a fairly generic candidate, that she was forfeiting the opportunity to more clearly define herself in the mind of the
sentences.zh: 然而，这样做的风险在于，作为一名相当普通的候选人，她放弃了在公众心目中更清晰地定义自己的机会。

sentences.en: public.
sentences.zh: 公众。

sentences.en: And I think that the polls suggest some early signs that now that that euphoria has faded, that the public is still hungering for a little bit more about Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 我认为民调显示出一些早期迹象，即现在狂热消退后，公众仍然渴望更多地了解卡玛拉·哈里斯。

sentences.en: And she hasn't provided it yet.
sentences.zh: 而她还没有提供这些信息。

sentences.en: And that that's hurting her a little bit among some critical constituencies that maybe don't pay
sentences.zh: 这在一些关键选民群体中对她造成了一定损害，这些选民可能不太关注政治，

sentences.en: as much attention to politics or who aren't as highly engaged in politics as others.
sentences.zh: 或者不像其他人那样高度参与政治。

sentences.en: And which voters exactly are we talking about, Nate?
sentences.zh: 内特，我们具体指的是哪些选民？

sentences.en: Well, I think we can break it down into a few groups.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为我们可以将其分为几组。

sentences.en: And I think one group of groups are the traditionally Democratic constituencies, young, black and
sentences.zh: 我认为其中一组是传统的民主党选民群体，即年轻选民、黑人选民和

sentences.en: Latino voters.
sentences.zh: 拉丁裔选民。

sentences.en: She's doing a lot better than Joe Biden was, but she's still not doing quite as well as Democrats usually do.
sentences.zh: 她的表现比乔·拜登好得多，但仍然没有达到民主党通常的水平。

sentences.en: So in the poll, we find Harris ahead 78 to 14 among black voters, for instance.
sentences.zh: 例如，在民调中，我们发现哈里斯在黑人选民中以78%对14%领先。

sentences.en: That's a lot better than Joe Biden was doing in many of our polls.
sentences.zh: 这比乔·拜登在我们许多民调中的表现要好得多。

sentences.en: But it's not the 90-10 sort of margin that Democrats usually get.
sentences.zh: 但这不是民主党通常能获得的90比10的优势。

sentences.en: And we can repeat that story for young voters and Latino voters as well.
sentences.zh: 对于年轻选民和拉丁裔选民，情况也是如此。

sentences.en: And in each of those cases, our poll finds a really disproportionate share of those voters saying that they don't feel like they've yet learned enough about Kamala Harris, that
sentences.zh: 在这些案例中，我们的民调发现，很大一部分选民表示他们觉得还没足够了解卡玛拉·哈里斯，

sentences.en: there's still a lot more that they need to learn before they're comfortable with her.
sentences.zh: 在对她感到放心之前，他们还需要了解更多信息。

sentences.en: Anyway, that's not so true for many other constituencies like college-educated voters or older voters.
sentences.zh: 不过，对于受过大学教育的选民或老年选民等许多其他群体来说，情况并非如此。

sentences.en: OK, so the same voters who were a problem for Biden are still a problem for Harris.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以那些曾经是拜登难题的选民，现在依然是哈里斯的难题。

sentences.en: I mean, she's improved on his numbers, but not so much that it's propelled her solidly into any sort of lead.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她的数据比他有所改善，但还没有改善到让她稳固领先的程度。

sentences.en: You know, these are voters who lean Democrat potentially, but are not necessarily coming home to the party just yet.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些选民可能倾向于民主党，但并不一定会立即回归该党。

sentences.en: And a big reason for that is because they don't know enough about her.
sentences.zh: 而这背后的一个重要原因是他们对她了解不够。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think the numbers are pretty striking.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这些数据非常引人注目。

sentences.en: You know, for young people, a majority of 18 to 29-year-olds say they feel like they need to learn more about Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对于年轻人来说，大多数18至29岁的人表示他们觉得需要更多地了解卡玛拉·哈里斯。

sentences.en: More than 40 percent of Black and Latino voters say the same.
sentences.zh: 超过40%的黑人和拉丁裔选民也表达了同样的看法。

sentences.en: And it may be that there is no deep problem here and that it's just a matter of time and
sentences.zh: 也许这里并没有什么深层问题，这只是时间问题，

sentences.en: that as voters tune in and see advertisements and watch debates, they'll come around to Kamala
sentences.zh: 随着选民开始关注、观看广告和辩论，他们会转而支持卡玛拉·哈里斯。

sentences.en: Harris.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯。

sentences.en: The poll doesn't really show that this is an extraordinarily deep problem, but it does show that she hasn't made the sale yet.
sentences.zh: 民调并没有真正显示这是一个极其严重的问题，但它确实表明她还没有完全赢得选民。

sentences.en: I mean, the thing that's really interesting about this is the fact that, you know, some key voters say they don't know much about her, but it's not like she hasn't staked out any
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这件事真正有趣的地方在于，你知道，一些关键选民说他们对她了解不多，但这并不是说她没有提出任何

sentences.en: policy positions, right?
sentences.zh: 政策立场，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, we did a whole episode about her economic plans for new homeowners and parents.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们专门做了一期关于她为新房主和父母制定的经济计划的节目。

sentences.en: But what this poll suggests is that that really isn't breaking through to people.
sentences.zh: 但这份民调表明，这些信息并没有真正传达给大众。

sentences.en: I mean, in fairness, it's only been a few weeks since she launched her candidacy.
sentences.zh: 公平地说，她宣布参选才不过几周时间。

sentences.en: And many of the groups we're talking about, young Black, Latino voters, these are not necessarily voters who are the most highly engaged.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的许多群体，年轻的黑人、拉丁裔选民，并不一定是参与度最高的选民。

sentences.en: They turn out at lower rates.
sentences.zh: 他们的投票率较低。

sentences.en: They watch cable news at lower rates.
sentences.zh: 他们观看有线电视新闻的频率也较低。

sentences.en: So it's entirely plausible that when these voters do tune in, and many will in time, that they'll find they like a lot of what Kamala Harris has to say.
sentences.zh: 所以完全可以预见，当这些选民开始关注时——许多人最终会关注——他们会发现自己很喜欢卡玛拉·哈里斯所说的大部分内容。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Most of the electorate is not living in the political science seminar that we are here at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 大多数选民并不生活在我们《纽约时报》这种政治学研讨会的环境中。

sentences.en: Most of the electorate is going about their daily lives, trying to find parking spaces and bringing their kids to school.
sentences.zh: 大多数选民都在过着日常生活，忙着找停车位，送孩子上学。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And when you're trying to think about how the polls change from week to week or month to month, that person probably had heard at some point something good about Kamala.
sentences.zh: 当你试图思考民调为何会逐周或逐月变化时，那个人可能在某个时候听说过关于卡玛拉的好消息。

sentences.en: You know, they hadn't necessarily heard her economic policies, but the vibes were good, as they say.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们不一定听过她的经济政策，但正如人们所说，氛围很好。

sentences.en: And that person was a little bit likelier to tell the pollster, oh, yeah, I'll vote for her.
sentences.zh: 那个人更有可能告诉民调人员，哦，是的，我会投票给她。

sentences.en: And now that that's gone away, there is nothing for them to hang on to at the moment.
sentences.zh: 而现在那种氛围消失了，他们目前没有什么可坚持的了。

sentences.en: She didn't fully make the sell.
sentences.zh: 她没有完全赢得他们的支持。

sentences.en: And now they've reverted back to being undecided or, in some cases, saying they'll vote for
sentences.zh: 现在他们又回到了未决状态，或者在某些情况下，表示会投票给

sentences.en: Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And that could change again between now and November.
sentences.zh: 从现在到十一月，这种情况可能会再次改变。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Trump is doing pretty well among those constituencies that usually back Republican candidates.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，特朗普在那些通常支持共和党候选人的群体中表现相当不错。

sentences.en: Donald Trump leads among voters over age 65 and over age 45 in the poll.
sentences.zh: 在民调中，唐纳德·特朗普在65岁以上和45岁以上的选民中处于领先地位。

sentences.en: He has a huge lead among white working class voters, 66 percent to 30 percent.
sentences.zh: 他在白人蓝领选民中拥有巨大优势，比例为66%对30%。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: And that group's around 40 percent of the electorate.
sentences.zh: 这个群体约占选民总数的40%。

sentences.en: It's more than black and Latino voters combined.
sentences.zh: 这比黑人和拉丁裔选民的总和还要多。

sentences.en: So that's a big advantage for him to have already sort of locked in, lock sided support among
sentences.zh: 所以，当卡玛拉·哈里斯还在努力重建民主党联盟的部分力量时，他已经锁定了核心选民的支持，这对他来说是一个巨大的优势。

sentences.en: his core constituencies while Kamala Harris is still working to rebuild parts of the Democratic coalition.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯。

sentences.en: So basically what we're seeing is that the gains she's made with Democrats turn out to be not enough to outweigh Trump's growing strength with white working class and with
sentences.zh: 所以基本上我们看到的是，她在民主党人中取得的进展，不足以抵消特朗普在白人蓝领和

sentences.en: older voters, at least so far.
sentences.zh: 老年选民中日益增长的优势，至少目前是这样。

sentences.en: So far.
sentences.zh: 目前是这样。

sentences.en: And it is worth noting, by the way, and emphasizing what you said, that this is growing strength.
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，值得强调你刚才所说的，这种优势正在增长。

sentences.en: Donald Trump is doing better among older voters and among white working class voters in this poll than he was against Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 在这份民调中，唐纳德·特朗普在老年选民和白人蓝领选民中的表现比他对抗乔·拜登时更好。

sentences.en: So there has been a little bit of a tradeoff here for Democrats in selecting a relatively liberal, younger, non-white candidate, perhaps, and that there's been just a little bit of
sentences.zh: 所以，民主党选择了一位相对自由派、年轻、非白人的候选人，可能确实存在一些权衡，

sentences.en: a tradeoff with groups that were Joe Biden's relative strength, even though he wasn't necessarily excelling among those voters either.
sentences.zh: 与那些曾经是乔·拜登相对优势的群体之间存在一些权衡，尽管他本人在这些选民中也不一定表现出色。

sentences.en: So where Biden was doing well with older voters, you know, chipping away at this white working class difference, Harris is actually falling behind.
sentences.zh: 所以，在拜登在老年选民中表现良好、削弱这种白人蓝领差异的地方，哈里斯实际上正在落后。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So if people don't quite know what her message is, what is it that they want?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果人们不太清楚她的主张是什么，他们想要什么呢？

sentences.en: What are they saying to you in this poll that they want that Harris is not giving them?
sentences.zh: 在这份民调中，他们告诉你他们想要什么，而哈里斯没有给他们？

sentences.en: Well, the overarching thing that voters say they want is change.
sentences.zh: 嗯，选民们说他们最想要的是改变。

sentences.en: Sixty one percent of voters say they want major change from Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 61%的选民表示他们希望乔·拜登做出重大改变。

sentences.en: A majority of voters say the country's heading in the wrong direction.
sentences.zh: 大多数选民表示国家正朝着错误的方向发展。

sentences.en: Only a quarter think the economy is good or excellent.
sentences.zh: 只有四分之一的人认为经济状况良好或极好。

sentences.en: This is a dissatisfied electorate.
sentences.zh: 这是一个不满的选民群体。

sentences.en: And at the moment, they're not convinced that Kamala Harris offers the solution to the problems that concern them.
sentences.zh: 目前，他们并不相信卡玛拉·哈里斯能为他们关心的问题提供解决方案。

sentences.en: Only 25 percent of voters say Kamala Harris represents major change.
sentences.zh: 只有25%的选民表示卡玛拉·哈里斯代表了重大变革。

sentences.en: A majority, 55 percent, call her more of the same.
sentences.zh: 大多数人，即55%，称她为“更多同样的东西”。

sentences.en: Donald Trump, in contrast, who in many respects is very much a candidate of the past, is seen as bringing major change by a majority of voters.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，唐纳德·特朗普在许多方面确实是一位过去式的候选人，但大多数选民认为他能带来重大变革。

sentences.en: And only 35 percent think he's more of the same.
sentences.zh: 只有35%的人认为他是“更多同样的东西”。

sentences.en: So at this time when Americans are dissatisfied and looking for something different, Donald
sentences.zh: 因此，在这个美国人感到不满并寻求不同选择的时刻，唐纳德·

sentences.en: Trump appears to have a really big advantage over Kamala Harris in representing a major departure from the status quo.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在代表背离现状的重大变革方面，似乎比卡玛拉·哈里斯拥有巨大的优势。

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太迷人了。

sentences.en: So in some of these voters' minds, Harris is an extension of Biden.
sentences.zh: 所以，在一些选民心目中，哈里斯是拜登的延伸。

sentences.en: I mean, if you're the Harris campaign and you're looking at this poll, you're probably going to want to create as much daylight as possible between your positions and Biden's
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你是哈里斯竞选团队，看着这份民调，你可能希望尽可能拉开你与拜登立场之间的距离。

sentences.en: positions.
sentences.zh: 立场。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And, you know, the poll suggests it's even a little worse than that for Harris and that voters don't just think she's sort of similar to Joe Biden.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，民调显示对哈里斯来说情况甚至更糟，选民不仅认为她和乔·拜登差不多，

sentences.en: They may also partly blame her for some of what they think is wrong with the country today.
sentences.zh: 他们可能还部分归咎于她，认为她对当今国家存在的一些问题负有责任。

sentences.en: I mean, more than half of voters, 63 percent of voters say she bears at least some of the blame for the problems at the border.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，超过一半的选民，即63%的选民表示，她对边境问题负有部分责任。

sentences.en: A majority say that she bears at least some of the blame for the state of the economy and rising prices.
sentences.zh: 多数人认为，对于当前的经济状况和物价上涨，她至少负有部分责任。

sentences.en: That's surprising to me.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到惊讶。

sentences.en: The vice president is hardly considered a powerful person.
sentences.zh: 副总统几乎不被认为是一个有实权的人。

sentences.en: But voters nonetheless associate her enough with the current administration that not only do they think she doesn't represent change, but she may also be partly responsible for
sentences.zh: 但选民们仍然将她与现任政府联系得太紧密，以至于他们不仅认为她代表不了变革，甚至认为她可能要为

sentences.en: what's wrong with the status quo.
sentences.zh: 现状的弊端承担部分责任。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: She's getting saddled with some of the worst things associated with the Biden administration, which is pretty interesting because it sort of, in a way, answers an open
sentences.zh: 她被强加了与拜登政府相关的一些最糟糕的标签，这很有意思，因为它在某种程度上回答了一个悬而未决的

sentences.en: question we had after the Democratic National Convention, which did a lot of work to tell her story as a change candidate.
sentences.zh: 问题，这是我们在民主党全国代表大会之后提出的，当时大会做了大量工作来讲述她作为变革型候选人的故事。

sentences.en: That was the story that they told about her.
sentences.zh: 那就是他们讲述的关于她的故事。

sentences.en: And when we came out of that convention, the question was, OK, you know, the people inside the convention hall believe that.
sentences.zh: 当我们从大会出来时，问题是，好吧，你知道，大会会场里的人相信这一点。

sentences.en: But did everybody else in the country?
sentences.zh: 但全国其他人呢？

sentences.en: And I think what it seems to be this poll is telling us is that we are starting to get an answer to that.
sentences.zh: 我认为这份民调似乎在告诉我们，我们开始得到答案了。

sentences.en: And the answer is, no, they didn't.
sentences.zh: 答案是，不，他们并不相信。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And not only did the convention fail to define her, but it left the Republicans with an opening to define her instead.
sentences.zh: 大会不仅没能定义她，反而给共和党留下了一个机会来定义她。

sentences.en: And the poll offers some hints that those Republican attacks are beginning to work and leave voters with an impression that the Harris campaign maybe doesn't want them to have.
sentences.zh: 民调提供了一些迹象，表明共和党的攻击开始奏效，并给选民留下了哈里斯竞选团队可能并不希望他们拥有的印象。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是 Winnalou。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一——《Connections》。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是 Sam Mazursky，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: So Nate, what have Republicans been able to do when it comes to defining Harris?
sentences.zh: 那么 Nate，在定义哈里斯方面，共和党人做到了什么？

sentences.en: I think the poll shows that they've made some progress on two fronts.
sentences.zh: 我认为民调显示他们在两个方面取得了一些进展。

sentences.en: She thinks she's going to bring down prices.
sentences.zh: 她认为她能降低物价。

sentences.en: Then why?
sentences.zh: 那为什么？

sentences.en: Here's a simple little few words.
sentences.zh: 这里有几句简单的话。

sentences.en: Why didn't you do it, Kamala?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不去做呢，卡玛拉？

sentences.en: Why didn't you do it?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不去做呢？

sentences.en: You've been there three and a half years.
sentences.zh: 你在那里已经三年半了。

sentences.en: One is in tying Harris to the Biden administration's policies on immigration and the economy.
sentences.zh: 一是将哈里斯与拜登政府在移民和经济方面的政策捆绑在一起。

sentences.en: I can say that with everything.
sentences.zh: 我可以对所有事情都这么说。

sentences.en: Why hasn't she secured the border?
sentences.zh: 为什么她没有守住边境？

sentences.en: You know, she was the border czar, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，她是边境沙皇，对吧？

sentences.en: She was the border czar.
sentences.zh: 她是边境沙皇。

sentences.en: It was a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这可是件大事。

sentences.en: Before the break, I mentioned that a majority of voters say she's partly responsible, at least, for the state of the border and rising prices.
sentences.zh: 在休息之前，我提到多数选民认为她至少对边境状况和物价上涨负有部分责任。

sentences.en: But she was in charge, and it was the worSt.
sentences.zh: 但她当时负责，而且情况是最糟的。

sentences.en: This was the worst border in history.
sentences.zh: 这是历史上最糟糕的边境。

sentences.en: There's never been a border in the world like this.
sentences.zh: 世界上从来没有过这样的边境。

sentences.en: They've also made some progress in defining her as too far to the left.
sentences.zh: 他们还在将她定义为“过于左倾”方面取得了一些进展。

sentences.en: Comrade Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: “同志”卡玛拉·哈里斯。

sentences.en: I call her comrade because she is a radical left MarxiSt.
sentences.zh: 我叫她同志，因为她是一个激进的左翼马克思主义者。

sentences.en: She wants open borders.
sentences.zh: 她想要开放边境。

sentences.en: We've heard Trump call her comrade Kamala.
sentences.zh: 我们听过特朗普称她为“同志卡玛拉”。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the poll shows some signs that that's working.
sentences.zh: 民调显示出一些迹象，表明这招奏效了。

sentences.en: Overall, 47% of likely voters say Harris is too liberal or too progressive on the issues.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，47% 的可能选民认为哈里斯在议题上过于自由派或过于进步。

sentences.en: That's not extraordinarily alarming for her campaign.
sentences.zh: 这对她的竞选团队来说并不算特别令人担忧。

sentences.en: It's under half.
sentences.zh: 还不到一半。

sentences.en: It's not necessarily a deal breaker for a majority of voters.
sentences.zh: 这对大多数选民来说不一定是决定性的因素。

sentences.en: But it's worth contrasting that with Trump's position as only 32% of voters say he's too conservative,
sentences.zh: 但值得将其与特朗普的立场进行对比，因为只有 32% 的选民认为他过于保守，

sentences.en: which implies that the preponderance of the electorate doesn't really have any reservations about Trump's ideological positioning at all.
sentences.zh: 这意味着绝大多数选民对特朗普的意识形态立场根本没有任何保留意见。

sentences.en: They don't think he's too far to the right in the same way that voters seem to think Harris is too far to the left.
sentences.zh: 他们并不认为他过于右倾，就像选民似乎认为哈里斯过于左倾那样。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: So she's still comrade Kamala, but he's occupying the political middle, which is surprising because Trump, I think, of as fairly far to the right on the issues.
sentences.zh: 所以她依然是“同志卡玛拉”，而他却占据了政治中间派，这很令人惊讶，因为我认为特朗普在议题上相当右倾。

sentences.en: I mean, immigration, abortion.
sentences.zh: 我是说，移民、堕胎。

sentences.en: How do you understand this finding and what you're seeing here?
sentences.zh: 你如何理解这一发现，以及你在这里看到了什么？

sentences.en: It's definitely true that there are some issues like immigration where Trump has staked out a pretty conservative position.
sentences.zh: 确实，在移民等一些问题上，特朗普确实采取了相当保守的立场。

sentences.en: But there are a lot of issues where Trump really isn't that conservative for a Republican.
sentences.zh: 但在很多问题上，对于共和党人来说，特朗普其实并没有那么保守。

sentences.en: I mean, if you a decade ago told me about a Republican who had the support of an RFK junior and Tulsi Gabbard but was opposed by Dick Cheney,
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果十年前你告诉我，有一位共和党人得到了小罗伯特·肯尼迪和图尔西·加巴德的支持，却遭到了迪克·切尼的反对，

sentences.en: who was pretty cagey on his position on abortion, by the way, even though he may have been responsible for appointing the justices who overturned Roe versus Wade.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，尽管他可能负责任命了推翻“罗诉韦德案”的大法官，但他对堕胎问题的立场却相当谨慎。

sentences.en: I think we would recognize that candidate as being one who was doing a lot of work to try and occupy something like the political middle.
sentences.zh: 我想我们会认为这位候选人正在努力占据政治中间地带。

sentences.en: And I think that's especially true on the economy as well as positions on trade and entitlements are very different than a Mitt Romney or Paul Ryan was.
sentences.zh: 我认为在经济以及贸易和福利政策方面尤其如此，这与米特·罗姆尼或保罗·瑞安非常不同。

sentences.en: I think he's done more work than people give credit for to position himself in a way that's amenable to a certain kind of populist moderate voter.
sentences.zh: 我认为他所做的努力比人们给予的评价要多，他将自己定位为一种受民粹主义温和派选民欢迎的人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He did kind of put his finger on something in the American electorate and change Republican orthodoxy.
sentences.zh: 他确实抓住了美国选民的一些心理，并改变了共和党的正统观念。

sentences.en: I mean, the fact that he speaks in favor of entitlements and not against is so different from the Paul Ryan era.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他支持而不是反对福利政策，这与保罗·瑞安时代截然不同。

sentences.en: And for millions of voters, that was what was most alienating about the old brand of Republican.
sentences.zh: 对于数百万选民来说，这正是旧式共和党品牌最让他们疏远的地方。

sentences.en: For a century, the Democrats were defined by being the party of the working class and against big business.
sentences.zh: 一个世纪以来，民主党的定义是工人阶级的政党，反对大企业。

sentences.en: And Donald Trump has complicated that story in a way that really matters.
sentences.zh: 而唐纳德·特朗普以一种真正重要的方式让这个故事变得复杂了。

sentences.en: OK, so what else does this poll tell us about Trump's strengths?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么这份民调还告诉我们关于特朗普的哪些优势？

sentences.en: I mean, you mentioned earlier that voters really see him as a change candidate, despite the fact that, you know, he's already been president.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你之前提到选民确实视他为变革型候选人，尽管他已经当过总统了。

sentences.en: We kind of know his policies.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道他的政策。

sentences.en: But I guess what this poll is suggesting is that he's a change from Biden.
sentences.zh: 但我猜这份民调暗示的是，他是拜登之后的变革。

sentences.en: As you said, that's what voters want.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，这就是选民想要的。

sentences.en: So where else is he doing well?
sentences.zh: 那么他在哪些方面做得很好？

sentences.en: I think the biggest thing that we haven't talked about is the economy.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们还没有谈到的最重要的事情是经济。

sentences.en: In every poll, we ask people what's the most important issue of their vote.
sentences.zh: 在每一份民调中，我们都会问人们投票时最关心的问题是什么。

sentences.en: And every time they say it's the economy and the cost of living.
sentences.zh: 他们每次都说是经济和生活成本。

sentences.en: And every time they also say that they think that Donald Trump would do a better job than the Democratic candidate, whether it was Joe Biden before or Kamala Harris now,
sentences.zh: 而且每次他们也说，他们认为唐纳德·特朗普会比民主党候选人做得更好，无论是之前的乔·拜登还是现在的卡玛拉·哈里斯，

sentences.en: at handling the issue.
sentences.zh: 在处理这个问题上。

sentences.en: In this poll, Donald Trump has a double-digit lead on who would do a better job of handling the economy.
sentences.zh: 在这份民调中，唐纳德·特朗普在谁能更好地处理经济问题上拥有两位数的领先优势。

sentences.en: And it's worth noting that his strength is particularly pronounced among some of those demographic groups we were talking about earlier, like young voters and Hispanic voters.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，他的优势在一些我们之前谈到的群体中尤为明显，比如年轻选民和拉美裔选民。

sentences.en: Those are two disproportionately low-income groups who say that Donald Trump is better on the economy than Kamala Harris by a pretty considerable margin,
sentences.zh: 这两个群体属于收入相对较低的群体，他们认为唐纳德·特朗普在经济方面比卡玛拉·哈里斯做得更好，优势相当明显，

sentences.en: even though those groups still narrowly back Harris overall.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些群体总体上仍然勉强支持哈里斯。

sentences.en: So that suggests a potential opportunity for Donald Trump and a liability for Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 所以这表明了唐纳德·特朗普的潜在机会，以及卡玛拉·哈里斯的软肋。

sentences.en: Does this poll show any potential weaknesses for Trump?
sentences.zh: 这份民调显示特朗普有任何潜在的弱点吗？

sentences.en: Oh, of course.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: I mean, Donald Trump is a deeply flawed candidate who very well might lose this election and lost the last one after all.
sentences.zh: 我是说，唐纳德·特朗普是一位有严重缺陷的候选人，他很有可能输掉这次选举，毕竟他上次就输了。

sentences.en: The poll shows that a majority of voters have an unfavorable view of him, as has been in the case in every time we see in a poll we've ever conducted.
sentences.zh: 民调显示，多数选民对他持负面看法，正如我们进行过的每一次民调中所见的那样。

sentences.en: A majority of voters say he's a risky choice for president, not a safe choice.
sentences.zh: 多数选民认为他是一个有风险的总统人选，而不是一个安全的选择。

sentences.en: Harris does have some advantages on the issues, too.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯在议题上也确实有一些优势。

sentences.en: She has a big advantage on abortion, which is the second most important issue after the economy in the poll.
sentences.zh: 她在堕胎问题上有很大优势，这是民调中仅次于经济的第二大重要议题。

sentences.en: She has a big advantage on democracy, another major issue for voters and one that was a big factor in the Democratic success in the midterm elections.
sentences.zh: 她在民主问题上有很大优势，这是选民关心的另一个重大议题，也是民主党在中期选举中取得成功的一个重要因素。

sentences.en: And Democrats also have an enthusiasm advantage in the poll.
sentences.zh: 而且民主党在民调中也拥有热情优势。

sentences.en: They were likelier to say they would vote than Republicans as well.
sentences.zh: 他们比共和党人更有可能表示会去投票。

sentences.en: And in a closely fought election, that could yield a slight turnout advantage that could easily be decisive.
sentences.zh: 在竞争激烈的选举中，这可能会带来微弱的投票率优势，而这很容易成为决定性因素。

sentences.en: So there are real reasons in the poll why Kamala Harris may ultimately win.
sentences.zh: 所以民调中确实有理由说明卡玛拉·哈里斯最终可能会获胜。

sentences.en: It's a really close race.
sentences.zh: 这是一场非常胶着的竞选。

sentences.en: And Donald Trump is no political juggernaut, despite all of the big advantages that he has in this race in terms of people wanting change and him being the candidate to offer it.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普绝非政治巨头，尽管他在这次竞选中拥有所有巨大的优势，比如人们渴望变革，而他正是提供变革的候选人。

sentences.en: So this poll is not all bad news for Harris and shows, as you said, just how close this race really is.
sentences.zh: 所以这份民调对哈里斯来说并非全是坏消息，正如你所说，它显示了这场竞选到底有多胶着。

sentences.en: Yeah, and close, honestly, is a little bit of an understatement.
sentences.zh: 是的，说胶着，老实说还有点保守了。

sentences.en: The polls today are closer than the polls were in 2020, than they were in 2016, 2012, 2004, 2000, really any election in the era of modern polling.
sentences.zh: 今天的民调比 2020 年、2016 年、2012 年、2004 年、2000 年的民调都要胶着，实际上是现代民调时代以来的任何一次选举。

sentences.en: And Kamala Harris is still a relatively undefined candidate.
sentences.zh: 而且卡玛拉·哈里斯仍然是一位相对定义模糊的候选人。

sentences.en: Voters want to hear more about her, and they're going to hear more about her over the next two months.
sentences.zh: 选民想听到更多关于她的信息，在接下来的两个月里，他们会听到更多。

sentences.en: So there's a lot of room for the race to shift, as close as it is today.
sentences.zh: 所以尽管今天竞争如此激烈，但竞选仍有很大的变数空间。

sentences.en: So, Nate, given everything that we've talked about, you know, the Harris strategy in this campaign has relied on being this idealized Democrat, not too fleshed out,
sentences.zh: 那么，Nate，鉴于我们谈到的一切，你知道，哈里斯在这场竞选中的策略一直依赖于成为这种理想化的民主党人，没有太具体的细节，

sentences.en: but standing for the popular elements of a theoretical Democratic candidacy.
sentences.zh: 但代表了理论上民主党候选人受欢迎的元素。

sentences.en: If that isn't working anymore or isn't working as well as she'd hoped, it does raise a lot of questions about her strategy.
sentences.zh: 如果这不再奏效，或者没有达到她预期的效果，这确实引发了关于她策略的许多问题。

sentences.en: I mean, it seems like what this poll is telling us is that just attacking Trump relentlessly, for example, is not enough,
sentences.zh: 我是说，这份民调似乎在告诉我们，仅仅不断攻击特朗普是不够的，

sentences.en: that she has to become something clearer in the minds of voters.
sentences.zh: 她必须在选民心中变得更加清晰。

sentences.en: You know, in other words, she can't afford to get away with just saying, I'm not Trump.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，她不能仅仅靠说“我不是特朗普”来蒙混过关。

sentences.en: You know, she has to actually articulate what it is that she stands for.
sentences.zh: 你知道，她必须真正阐明她的立场。

sentences.en: I think there's a lot of truth to that.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很有道理。

sentences.en: I mean, I think voters are going to need to have some clear sense of who she is and what she stands for.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我认为选民需要清楚地了解她是谁以及她的立场。

sentences.en: There's still time for her to provide that answer to voters.
sentences.zh: 她还有时间向选民提供这个答案。

sentences.en: But if they don't, the Trump campaign is going to do it.
sentences.zh: 但如果她不这样做，特朗普竞选团队就会替她做。

sentences.en: The other issue, though, is that they probably do eventually need to make this campaign about Trump again.
sentences.zh: 不过另一个问题是，他们最终可能确实需要让这场竞选再次围绕特朗普展开。

sentences.en: Harris is a much more popular candidate than Joe Biden was.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯是一位比乔·拜登更受欢迎的候选人。

sentences.en: But fundamentally, an up or down referendum on Donald Trump is the clearest path to a Democratic victory in this election.
sentences.zh: 但从根本上说，对唐纳德·特朗普进行肯定或否定的公投，是民主党在这次选举中获胜的最清晰途径。

sentences.en: That's how Joe Biden won last time was by almost being irrelevant and then allowing voters to cast an up or down vote on whether they wanted four more years of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登上一次就是这样赢的，他几乎保持沉默，然后让选民对是否想要唐纳德·特朗普再执政四年进行肯定或否定的投票。

sentences.en: If Harris can get back to that point where she's not so important and the only thing voters are doing is voting on whether they like Trump or not, that could be a win for her.
sentences.zh: 如果哈里斯能回到那个状态，即她不那么重要，而选民唯一做的事情就是投票决定他们是否喜欢特朗普，那对她来说可能就是一场胜利。

sentences.en: But in order to get there,
sentences.zh: 但为了达到这一点，

sentences.en: she needs to sort of solve some of these problems and make voters comfortable with her so that they can then let their dislike of Trump be the decisive factor in the race.
sentences.zh: 她需要解决其中一些问题，让选民对她感到放心，这样他们才能让对特朗普的反感成为竞选的决定性因素。

sentences.en: And the debate coming up is the first of many opportunities that she'll have to close that sale over the final two months of this election.
sentences.zh: 即将到来的辩论是她在这场选举最后两个月里完成这一目标的众多机会中的第一个。

sentences.en: And to that point, the debate on Tuesday, what should we be looking for, Nate?
sentences.zh: 说到这一点，周二的辩论，我们应该关注什么，Nate？

sentences.en: One easy way to look at the debate is just whether it's fundamentally about Harris or whether it's fundamentally about Trump.
sentences.zh: 看待辩论的一个简单方法是看它从根本上是关于哈里斯，还是关于特朗普。

sentences.en: If after the debate we're talking about Harris's flip flops on the issues or whether she's too far to the left or her handling of immigration, she's in trouble.
sentences.zh: 如果辩论后我们讨论的是哈里斯在议题上的反复无常，或者她是否过于左倾，或者她对移民的处理，那她就有麻烦了。

sentences.en: She's not going to win the election, any of those issues.
sentences.zh: 她赢不了选举，无论涉及哪个议题。

sentences.en: The most she can do is be able to move past them to sort of satisfy those concerns enough to focus on Trump.
sentences.zh: 她能做的最多就是超越这些问题，以某种方式满足这些担忧，从而专注于特朗普。

sentences.en: So if we're talking instead about Donald Trump's conduct on January 6th, his views on abortion, Project 2025, if we're talking about his behavior,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我们讨论的是唐纳德·特朗普在 1 月 6 日的行为、他对堕胎的看法、“2025 计划”，如果我们讨论的是他的行为，

sentences.en: like was the case after the first presidential debate in 2020,
sentences.zh: 就像 2020 年第一次总统辩论之后那样，

sentences.en: that's a sign that not only did Harris sort of satisfy these concerns that we've been talking about, but she also then allowed the election to pivot back towards Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 那是一个信号，表明哈里斯不仅满足了我们一直在谈论的这些担忧，而且她还让选举重新转向了唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: In the end, Harris needs this election to be about Donald Trump for her to win.
sentences.zh: 最终，哈里斯需要这场选举围绕唐纳德·特朗普展开，她才能获胜。

sentences.en: She has to be able to satisfy the concerns about her and then turn the focus back on him.
sentences.zh: 她必须能够消除人们对她的担忧，然后将焦点转回他身上。

sentences.en: Well, Nate.
sentences.zh: 好的，Nate。

sentences.en: Sabrina.
sentences.zh: Sabrina。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: We'll be watching.
sentences.zh: 我们会持续关注。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该知道的消息。

sentences.en: On Friday, the judge overseeing Donald Trump's criminal case in Manhattan postponed his sentencing until after Election Day,
sentences.zh: 周五，负责唐纳德·特朗普在曼哈顿刑事案件的法官将他的量刑推迟到了选举日之后，

sentences.en: a significant victory for Trump as he tries to overturn his conviction and win back the White House.
sentences.zh: 这对特朗普来说是一次重大胜利，因为他正试图推翻定罪并重返白宫。

sentences.en: In his ruling, Judge Juan Mershon cited the, quote, unique time frame this matter currently finds itself in.
sentences.zh: 胡安·默尚法官在裁决中引用了此案目前所处的“特殊时间框架”。

sentences.en: He had previously planned to hand down Trump's punishment on September 18th.
sentences.zh: 他原计划于9月18日对特朗普进行宣判。

sentences.en: Just seven weeks before Election Day.
sentences.zh: 那距离选举日仅剩七周。

sentences.en: While the decision will avert a courtroom spectacle before the election, the delay itself could still affect its results,
sentences.zh: 虽然这一决定避免了选举前在法庭上出现闹剧，但延期本身仍可能影响选举结果，

sentences.en: keeping voters in the dark about whether Trump will eventually spend time behind bars.
sentences.zh: 让选民们无法得知特朗普最终是否会入狱服刑。

sentences.en: And in Venezuela, the opposition leader who was widely seen as the true winner of this summer's presidential elections fled the country to Spain.
sentences.zh: 在委内瑞拉，被广泛视为今年夏天总统大选真正获胜者的反对派领导人已逃往西班牙。

sentences.en: Edmundo González is globally recognized as the winner of Venezuela's presidential elections in July.
sentences.zh: 埃德蒙多·冈萨雷斯被全球公认为委内瑞拉7月总统大选的获胜者。

sentences.en: But that country's election board instead announced Nicolas Maduro, the incumbent, as the winner.
sentences.zh: 但该国选举委员会却宣布现任总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗获胜。

sentences.en: Last week, Maduro's government issued a detention order against González, accusing him of, quote, crimes associated with terrorism and prompting him to go into hiding.
sentences.zh: 上周，马杜罗政府对冈萨雷斯发出了逮捕令，指控他犯有所谓的“与恐怖主义相关的罪行”，迫使他躲藏起来。

sentences.en: Since the election, more than 2,000 people have been arrested and dozens have been killed in protests throughout the country.
sentences.zh: 自大选以来，全国各地的抗议活动中已有超过2000人被捕，数十人丧生。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Carlos Prieto and Nina Feldman.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由卡洛斯·普列托和尼娜·费尔德曼制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Rachel Quester, with help from Patricia Willans.
sentences.zh: 由雷切尔·奎斯特编辑，帕特里夏·威兰斯提供协助。

sentences.en: Contains original music by Rowan Nemisto and Alicia Baitube.
sentences.zh: 包含罗文·内米斯托和艾丽西亚·拜图布的原创音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由克里斯·伍德负责工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Bunberg and Ben Lansford of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·邦伯格和本·兰斯福德创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为您准备假期接待客人的相关内容。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，了解如何让您的客人在家中感到宾至如归。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要全黑的睡眠环境吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会喝到断片才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 您可以在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何播客平台收听《Wirecutter秀》。
